parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of polypropylene plastic, typically cylindrical and hollow to fit over the pen tip.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip from drying out and prevents ink leakage when not in use. It may also have a clip for attaching to pockets or notebooks.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or pushing, sometimes with a snap fit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of ABS plastic, cylindrical in shape and houses the ink refill.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural support, holds the ink reservoir, and serves as the gripping area for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, though the internal ink refill may move slightly when replaced.
